---
name: Report a reproducible issue
about: Describe a citation, matching, import, or packaging problem
---

**Versions** (Windows, desktop Word, EndNote/CWYW, DSH, Python)

**Reproduction** (invented records or public DOI, small example sentence, command or DSH request)

**Expected and observed results** (citation groups, reference count, reused/added/reviewed records)

**Failure stage** (install, index, preview, prepare, format, publish, or reopen/edit)

Use redacted text and counts. Keep private PDFs, Word files, EndNote libraries and raw diagnostic reports on your computer.
